music.prompt: Sparse, original instrumental blending a lonely spaghetti-western mood with Japanese folk colour at about seventy beats per minute: twangy baritone guitar, breathy shakuhachi, soft taiko and a dry wood block, not any known theme. It opens tense and empty like a dusty street at noon, settles into a quiet plucked shamisen-and-guitar pulse in the middle, then builds gently with low taiko and a held shakuhachi note before ending on one soft guitar harmonic.

sfx.prompt: dry desert wind gusting through an empty street, dust and grit, distant creaking wooden sign
a katana slowly drawn from a wooden scabbard, crisp metallic ring
cowboy boots with jingling spurs walking slowly on wooden boardwalk planks
a single wooden judge's gavel strike in a quiet courtroom with short reverb
a calligraphy brush stroking across rice paper, soft and close, then paper being folded
a heavy stone seal stamp pressed firmly onto paper, one solid thump
old metal coins clinking and settling onto a brass scale pan
a vintage film projector starting up and running, rhythmic clatter of the reel
flipping through the pages of an old paperback book quickly, then it snaps shut
a soft airy whoosh transition with a faint wooden clack at the end
